Article title: Connecting Captions · local-host.ai
Description: On-device live captions on a Mac. Speech and translation stay on the machine. For presentations, bilingual rooms, and any conversation that needs a translation.
HN text: Hi HN, I built Connecting Captions, a live captioning and translation overlay for macOS that runs entirely on-device. Nothing goes over the network: no API calls, no audio leaving your machine, and it keeps working offline. I wanted live translation I could use in meetings and conversations without worrying about connectivity, latency spikes, or sending sensitive audio to a third party. The technically interesting part is a low-latency, self-correcting pipeline for speech-to-text and translation.
